quarters.title: The Closing Scenes
quarters.description: The Bible makes an incredible claim about God in 1 John 4:8: God is love. It doesn’t say He merely possesses a certain amount of love or is occasionally loving, but that He is the embodiment and source of all true love. In 1 Corinthians 13:5, we learn that love, by its very nature, is not self-centered—it focuses on others. Nowhere is this “other-centered” love more vividly displayed than in the closing scenes of Jesus’ life on earth.

quarters.title: The Gift of Prophecy
quarters.description: Neuroscientists have begun to understand human infants’ incredible ability to learn language. At six months of age, a baby can understand the sounds that comprise any of the seven thousand-plus spoken languages in the world. If exposed to a second language, they can acquire that language as well. During this period, a mysterious mental door opens, allowing infants to distinguish the forty or so sounds that generally make up a native language from the eight hundred different sounds that they can perceive at birth. But there is one catch: babies must be spoken to. You might call it voice lessons for newborns.

quarters.title: Apologetics: Mars Hill
quarters.description: In the ever-evolving landscape of faith and spirituality, young adults often stand at the crossroads of belief and skepticism. The questions they face are profound, and the answers they seek are not always straightforward. This is where apologetics comes in—a discipline that equips believers to defend their faith with reason and clarity. As we embark on this journey together, let us explore the importance of apologetics and what it means in our personal lives.

quarters.title: Colliding Kingdoms
quarters.description: These lessons are about God’s kingdom of grace and being a recruited agent (steward, citizen) of that kingdom. There is a battle going on between God’s kingdom and the kingdom of evil. Being agents of God’s kingdom requires action. We can’t just listen to what Jesus asks of us—we are to do it (James 1:22) if we want to be effective agents of the kingdom on this earth. The first lesson of each quarter covers a different section of Jesus’ sermon on the mount, which is “at once Christ’s inaugural address as king of the kingdom of grace and also the constitution of the kingdom” (The Seventh-day Adventist Bible Commentary, vol. 5, p. 322). After the first lesson of each quarter the rest of the lessons are about the different challenges, rights, or privileges in the “real time” of being an agent of God’s kingdom. A Christian never knows what he or she will be encountering next. Remember to go to http://guidemagazine.org/rtf and explore each week’s topic with other e-teens. Find out how other young people are facing the challenge of living for God in the real world.

quarters.title: The Gift of Special Messages
quarters.description: Neuro scientists study how nerves, the brain, and spinal cord work. They are starting to understand better how the brains of babies work. At 6 months old, a baby can understand many sounds that are part of the English language. If babies hear another language at that time, they can learn that language, too. During this time, babies can understand the 40 or more sounds that are part of their parents’ language. They can tell these sounds apart from the 800 other sounds they can understand when they are born. But for babies to develop this special skill, something important must happen first. People must speak to the babies. So, you can say that speaking to a baby is the same as ‘voice lessons’ for newborns!
